verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an on-prem container with a Helm chart for Kubernetes, including a lightweight surya-us container type, so its models can run on customer-controlled infrastructure. That route requires an Enterprise contract. The free self-hostable path is the open-source Marker, Chandra and Surya engines, not the full platform (pipelines, form filling, webhooks). missing for 10: self-hosting without an Enterprise contract, documentation that the on-prem deployment covers the full platform feature set, independent or hands-on corroboration of an on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Customers can run our models on infrastructure they control with an Enterprise contract.
A Helm chart is available for deploying the container on Kubernetes clusters.
New surya-us on-premises container type — a lightweight Chandra-compatible container
while Chandra, Marker, and Surya remain free open source
